easyPrerequisites: All-Fates Stalker must be exiled by Lagrella, and Yannik must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Yannik for its mana cost.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Lagrella until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, All-Fates Stalker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it exiles Yannik until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of All-Fates Stalker's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles All-Fates Stalker until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
